R409.note: toRealPath() canonicalization on both base and target plus startsWith containment check correctly closes symlink/traversal escape and matches the stated contract.

R410.note: Switches raw-socket RESP string concatenation to StackExchange.Redis IConnectionMultiplexer with args as separate array elements; same key/fields/values preserved, no legitimate data lost.

R411.note: Tika content-sniffed MIME allowlist, random UUID filename, and storage outside webroot is the intrinsic fix shape for CWE-434, not incidental overreach.

R412.note: Filter pattern 'evalcases.OrderEvent;java.*' has no trailing '!*' reject-all; verified against real JDK 26 that an arbitrary HashMap deserializes successfully through this exact filter (UNDECIDED defaults to ALLOWED), so gadget classes are not actually blocked and the vulnerability is not closed.

R413.note: Replaces Math.random() with a shared SecureRandom generating 128 bits, Base64-encoded; token role in cookie/session comparison is unchanged.

R414.note: Regex rejects CRLF/whitespace in both addresses before they reach smtp.docmd, fail-closed with 400; pattern is loose enough to accept ordinary email addresses.

R415.note: ObjectInputFilter allowlist with module-scoped 'java.base/*' plus explicit '!*' reject-all; verified against real JDK 26 that the legitimate record still deserializes while a non-java.base class is rejected, exactly matching the stated contract.

R416.note: Removes the shell invocation entirely and echoes the parameter directly via the response writer, eliminating the command-execution attack surface with equivalent visible output.

R417.note: Rejects '..'/absolute paths up front and additionally canonicalizes+verifies containment via toRealPath/getCanonicalFile before opening; preserves the existing try/catch/finally flow.

R418.note: Build FAILs (CS0119: 'File' resolves to inherited ControllerBase.File method, not System.IO.File) so scores 0 on fix_quality; the rewrite also silently swaps dynamic batch-script report generation for reading a pre-existing static file, changing endpoint behavior beyond the injection fix without flagging that report generation itself is gone.

R419.note: Allowlist lookup map for require() targets is the prescribed fix shape for dynamic-require path traversal; unknown names rejected with 400 before reaching require.

R420.note: Standard JSTL <c:out> auto-escaping replaces the raw scriptlet expression in an HTML body context; null-default behavior and displayed text are otherwise unchanged.
